claim.text: The frozen finite L17 formulas survive a separately implemented literal comparator, ACAF boundary/context probes and specified live-source mutants; the new critic has a corrected zero-repetition regression.
claim.scope: 6381 endpoints, 192 window contexts, finite controls, 20 specified mutants and 2100 conditional arithmetic edges. No new Lean theorem or infinite continuation.
assumptions: Literal L17 table and blank-exterior complete-tape semantics.
The separate claim transcription and all code paths are by the same author.
The incoming blank boundary is supplied by Claude and not independently built here.
forbidden_promotions: No external independent replication or independent human transcription.
No complete stacked closure, unbounded-depth theorem, non-halting or new certified Cryptid.
Twenty selected mutant kills do not mean complete coverage.
Huge integer/trace checks are arithmetic, not raw runs at those times.

specification.intended_object: Exact physical endpoints, raw time, head/state/halting, locality, guard contracts, equivalent representations and the frozen symbolic chain.
invariants: Only exterior trailing zeros are implicit; leading/interior cells retain position.
Undefined transitions halt without a successful write or move.
Critic consumes the exact hashed claims.json file and imports no actor dependencies.
Fresh raw work is bounded and cached outputs require identical request/response/binary hashes.
known_answer_cases: Blank A reaches C with two ones after two transitions.
F reading one halts at zero defined transitions, including zero budget.
Write/erase-only tables and all-undefined table have analytic endpoints.
Zero copies of 10 equal empty; source 001 has its one at position 2.

structural: Critic dependency isolation and quiet imports with no working-directory writes.
All 31 consumed frozen actor files verified unchanged before/after.

metamorphic: 84 identical requests at O2, O0 and UBSan; full outputs agree.

matched_baselines: Same literal input, state, head, machine and defined-transition budget for declarative expected output and C++ raw machine.
Compiler settings share the same source and 84 matched requests.
negative_controls: Changed transition and wrong start after state renaming are rejected as equivalences.
Live-source target/time/head/context/guard/encoder defects are detected; no expected-value-only mutation is counted.
controls.compute_parity: No timing comparison. Cumulative actual work includes failed attempts and cache misses; fresh batches are preflight-bounded.
controls.parameter_parity: Identical complete source state for each comparison, or explicitly recorded frame transport.
controls.sampling_parity: Fixed original queues and a prospective deterministic new seed, suffix-length/density grid and explicit guards. No uniform-time or probabilistic inference.
controls.data_access_parity: Full support available to the comparator; actor imports stay behind the explicit adapter. Hash-bound cached literal outputs are rechecked against current expected values.

preregistration.prediction: Local prospective protocol/claim/mutation records before their runs, not external authenticated preregistration. Preserve all corrections without changing seed or source claims.
preregistration.primary_metric: Zero mismatched physical endpoints and read windows; separately report all specified mutant outcomes.
preregistration.uncertainty_method: Exact finite checks, full traces, short-string oracles and a self-contained period-lemma derivation; no p-value or infinite-orbit inference.
preregistration.kill_condition: Any mismatch suspends that claim on its stated guard. Preserve the failing record and shrink within 128 attempts.
preregistration.stop_condition: 2048 new ACAF endpoints and the fixed control counts; <=200000 defined transitions per request and <=80000000 cumulative actual C++ transitions including failed attempts. No orbit extension.
preregistration.promotion_rule: Finite agreement remains M. Actual Lean theorem statements/builds and separate reachable closure are required for stronger conclusions.

primary_sources: Literal L17 machine and user-supplied Claude brief.
PERIOD-COMPARATOR.md contains the exact mathematical argument used; classic bibliography and abstract corroboration are named without claiming a retrieved original proof.
